description: This file contains unit tests for the OnboardingStateStore component, which manages onboarding state using UserDefaults. The tests verify behaviors like presenting onboarding on launch, marking completion, and resetting state.

classes.name: OnboardingStateStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for the OnboardingStateStore, verifying onboarding presentation logic, persistence of user interactions, and reset behavior.

methods.name: shouldPresentWhenFreshAndDisconnected
methods.description: Tests that onboarding should present when the app is fresh and not connected.

methods.name: doesNotPresentWhenConnected
methods.description: Verifies that onboarding does not present when the app is connected.

methods.name: markCompletedPersistsMode
methods.description: Checks that marking onboarding completed persists the mode and prevents re-presentation.

methods.name: firstRunIntroDefaultsToVisibleThenPersists
methods.description: Tests that the first-run introduction is visible initially and then persists as seen.

methods.name: resetClearsCompletionAndIntroSeen
methods.description: Ensures that resetting onboarding clears completion and intro seen flags, making onboarding present again.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates unique UserDefaults suite for testing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the UserDefaults for a test suite.
